Building Types Not Included In ResStock | ResStock

item.text:
ResStock **excludes dormitories and assisted care facilities, but includes high-rise apartment buildings**.

| Building type | Included? |
|---|---|
| Dormitories | No |
| Assisted care facilities | No |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes—as high-rise multifamily housing, even when building codes classify them as commercial |

ResStock follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a housing unit, which excludes congregate housing such as dormitories and assisted care facilities. Source: [ResStock, “Building Types Not Represented in ResStock”](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/resources/explanations/Building_Types.html).
